title: Make craze vaporware-aware in code — read CrateModel + x-craze-collapse-path annotations, emit craze-collapse-receipts, become the substrate-canonical vaporware-collapse gate in IMPLEMENTATION not just doctrine
createdBy: Chief of Staff (clia) per operator-direction 2026-06-11 'we need to make craze vaporware aware'
operatorQuote: 2026-06-11: 'we need to make craze vaporware aware'
problemStatement: craze TODAY is install/build/run/pass/setup — it has NO awareness of substrate-vapor concept in code. The axiom names craze as the substrate-canonical vaporware-collapse gate, but the CLI doesn't read typed records, doesn't honor x-craze-collapse-path annotations, doesn't emit collapse-receipts, doesn't refuse permanent-vapor invocation, doesn't enumerate vapor at a path. The axiom is doctrine-only until craze gains code-side awareness. This bead bridges the doctrine layer (typed records authored across 2 fan-in cycles) to the implementation layer (craze CLI behavior).

phase0_textBasedVaporAwareness.scope: Text-based recognition of vapor annotations in JSON files. No schema dependency. Smallest viable lift — ships in a single craze release without waiting for the coordinated cut v0.0.1.
deliverables: New mode: `craze status --path <dir>` — walks the path, scans .json files for `"x-craze-collapse-path":` key, reports per-file: collapse-status (collapsed/collapse-pending/collapse-blocked/permanent-vapor/unannotated), pendingCapabilityRefs counts, collapseGateRefs counts.
New mode: `craze inventory --path <dir>` — emits typed JSON vapor-inventory for the path (later: typed CrateInventoryReceiptModel; for now: untyped 0.1.0-untyped shape).
Help-banner update: existing modes' help text names craze as the substrate-canonical vaporware-collapse gate.

Internal command-name fix: ArgumentParser command-name + help banner says 'savepoint@kura-org.cli' format (composes with FR-SAVEPOINT-CLI-RENAME naming-pattern catch — craze SHOULD already say craze@wrkstrm-core.cli internally; audit + fix if drifted).
phase0_textBasedVaporAwareness.blockingDependencies: none - this is the smallest viable lift

phase1_typedInternalTypes.scope: Add craze-INTERNAL Swift typed structs for CrateModel + CrazeCollapsePath + CrazeCollapseReceipt. Per cameron's Phase-1-internal-then-Phase-2-schema-family argument (which operator OVERRULED for schema-universal — but craze-internal types can ship NOW without schema dependency). Composes with cameron's draftSwiftCodableSketches from the architecture-reframe fan-in.
deliverables: Swift Codable internal types in craze sources: CrateModel (kind discriminator + per-kind detail), CrazeCollapsePath (status enum + collapseGateRefs + pendingCapabilityRefs), CrazeCollapseReceipt (success/partial/failed + observed world-state-delta).
Internal CrazeMode -> CrateKind discriminator mapping (e.g., --artifact app + --xcode-project = xcode-scheme-app kind).

New mode: `craze realize <typed-record-path>` — reads a typed JSON record, derives CrateModel + CrazeCollapsePath, dispatches to existing install/build/run based on the CollapsePath.collapseGateRefs[].
Behind-flag: `--vapor-aware` opt-in for existing modes to read + honor x-craze-collapse-path on the named artifact's typed declaration.

phase2_schemaUniversalIntegration.scope: Switch craze-internal types to consume the typed schema-universal primitives once the coordinated cut v0.0.1 lands. Schema-family conformance via Swift codegen from JSON Schemas.
deliverables: Replace craze-internal CrateModel struct with the typed crate-schemas v0.0.1 CrateModel Swift package.
Replace craze-internal CrazeCollapsePath struct with the typed craze-collapse-path-annotation-convention envelope.
Replace craze-internal CrazeCollapseReceipt struct with the typed craze-collapse-receipt-schemas v0.0.1 Swift package.
Update `craze status` + `craze inventory` to emit fully-typed receipts conforming to the schema family.
Update `craze realize` to dispatch based on typed CrateKind enum.
phase2_schemaUniversalIntegration.blockingDependencies: FR-VAPOR-COORDINATION-CUT-v0.0.1 must ship first; Phase 1 must ship first

phase3_fullVaporCollapseGate.scope: Full vaporware-collapse gate behavior: refuse invocations against permanent-vapor declarations (without --override), emit typed collapse-receipt on every successful install/build/run, integrate with Creative Selection v0.0.5 cycle output (read CollapseBudgetReceiptModel to know which vapor has board-approved budget).
deliverables: Vapor-refusal: `craze install --crate <slug>` refuses if CrateModel.collapsePath.status == 'permanent-vapor' (override via --force-collapse-permanent-vapor).
Vapor-warning: `craze install` warns if no x-craze-collapse-path annotation found on a typed-record-like input.
Collapse-receipt emission: every successful install/build/run emits typed CrazeCollapseReceipt.json next to the installed artifact + at the cited typed record's receiptRefs[].
Creative Selection v0.0.5 cycle integration: `craze cycle <cycle-id>` reads the CollapseBudgetReceiptModel for the cycle + executes approved collapse-budget allocations in priority order.
Cadence-mark update: every collapse updates the typed record's x-cadence-mark.collapsedAt field per coordinated cut v0.0.1 primitive #9.
phase3_fullVaporCollapseGate.blockingDependencies: Phase 2 must ship first; coordinated cut v0.0.1 must include cadence-mark fields + risk-classification annotation

criticalUserJourney.actor: Substrate agent (clia, common, cameron) OR operator (rismay) acting in collapse-budget allocation review
phase0Journey: craze walks the dir, finds *.json files, scans for x-craze-collapse-path annotations.
Output: per-file vapor classification + summary table (X collapsed, Y collapse-pending, Z permanent-vapor, W unannotated).
Agent uses this to identify what to collapse next, without manually grep-ing 50 JSON files.
phase3Journey: Operator OD-N's a Creative Selection v0.0.5 CollapseBudgetReceiptModel approving Launch Control collapse-priority #1.
craze reads the CollapseBudgetReceiptModel, finds the rank-1 allocation (Launch Control), reads the linked CrateModel records, dispatches build/install per priority order.
On success: craze emits typed CrazeCollapseReceipt at each collapsed CrateModel's receiptRefs[] + updates the cycle receipt with completion status.

successCriteria: After Phase 0: `craze status --path <dir>` works on any substrate dir + emits useful vapor classification.
After Phase 1: `craze realize <typed-record-path>` collapses a typed record without requiring operator to manually compose --product/--scheme/--artifact flags.
After Phase 2: craze receipts conform to the typed schema family + are validatable via typed-record-validator-cli (when it ships).
After Phase 3: craze refuses permanent-vapor invocations; Creative Selection cycles execute via `craze cycle` not manual per-artifact craze install loops.
